resources.string:
Share a one-time installation report when you have internet. It contains a random installation ID and app version. Our server also receives the connection IP address, but does not save it in the install counter.

Your name, contacts, messages and payment details stay out of this report. Payments still work without internet.

This is optional. Change your choice in Settings. Turning it off stops unsent reports; it does not remove a report already counted.
